name: 冷蓝青绿月报
description: 冷蓝与青绿强调的经营分析风，适合月报、复盘和决策汇报
taboos: 数据必须标时间与口径
coverStructure: photographic scale cue plus one KPI/decision anchor
sectionStructure: chapters use calm review cadence and explicit takeaway
titleTreatment: compact executive title with blue band/green status cue
decorativeLanguage: architectural crop, metric rule and small line icon
bodyCompositionBias: data blocks are unequal: conclusion and variance lead

density.guidance: 信息可较密，但每页仍保留一个主判断和清晰证据路径

tocStructure: calm contents ledger: chapter, page range, one-line takeaway
heroStructure: one KPI figure with a single sentence of context and a thin rule
